_comment: Denominator guard for coverage-gate-v2 (verbara-meta/ADR-0013), verbara-website variant. Net-new-only ratchet, mirroring Web's coverage-exclusion-baseline.json: counts vitest v8 '/* c8 ignore */' markers across the source glob (dist + node_modules excluded). Net-new occurrences FAIL the build; lower 'count' by hand only when you delete an exclusion. Stops the 'shrink the denominator to dodge both coverage gates' laundering vector. Checked by scripts/check-exclusion-baseline.py (byte-identical to Web + the .NET repos; the 'marker' key retargets it to the c8 form). NOTE: the script uses Python stdlib glob.glob, which does NOT expand '{ts,tsx,js,jsx}' braces; 'src/**/*.[tj]s*' is the stdlib-compatible equivalent that matches ts/tsx/js/jsx. This is an Astro marketing site — the src TS tree is small; the unit-tier denominator lives in scripts/functions/src, and this guard tracks the src subtree where a c8 exclusion is most plausibly added. Baseline as of 2026-07-21: 0 markers over 5 src source files.
